author: Russell Brand
description:
A joking conversation between Russell and Dr. Stella Immanuel unexpectedly turns into a deeper discussion about faith, character and what happens after someone gives their life to Christ.

Russell explains why he sometimes uses provocative language to wake people up and keep serious spiritual conversations accessible. Dr. Immanuel pushes back, arguing that salvation should eventually begin to transform even the habits and character traits we once took for granted.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Jonathan Otto tells Russell about research involving men with prostate cancer and a treatment combining red light with a photosensitizing agent. He argues that the results point to the potential of light-based therapies and explains why he believes this area deserves far more attention.
